Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to unsuspend this card if it digivolves while suspended?

Card Q&A.a: No. If an effect unsuspends a card that's already unsuspended, it doesn't count as unsuspending it.
Card Q&A.q: I have a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards. If that Digimon is already unsuspended, does an effect that reads "unsuspend 1 of your Digimon" activate this card's inherited effect?

Effect: [When Digivolving] If you have a blue Tamer in play, unsuspend 1 of your blue Digimon.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] When this Digimon becomes unsuspended during your main phase, it gains ＜Jamming＞ (This Digimon can't be deleted in battles against Security Digimon) for the turn.
